message: This preview is a saved Austin sample, so it opens without a server. Live listings for every city turn on when a RentCast key is connected.

metrics.occupancy_target: San Francisco review model: reviews in the last year / 0.5, times the city stay or the listing minimum (capped at 14 nights), divided by 365, capped at 70%. A full calendar with no reviews is not treated as booked.
metrics.seasonality: Applied at prediction time from city seasonal factors. The model itself predicts the annual typical rate.
